subject: reading
passage_with_gaps: The park was beautiful in spring. {GAP_1} Birds sang in the trees. {GAP_2} Children played happily on the swings.
sentences: Flowers bloomed in every garden bed.|Families spread picnic blankets on the grass.|Snow covered the frozen pond.
solution: The first two sentences describe a spring day in order. The third is a distractor because snow does not fit a spring scene.
